{"document": {"code": """"Rectangular Four-Hole Block — Engineering Design Specification

R01: One 60 x 40 x 12 mm block in a right-handed millimetre frame,
occupying X=0..60, Y=0..40, Z=0..12 with the origin at the lower-left
bottom corner.
R02: Four individual plain diameter-6 mm through holes, parallel to Z,
at global XY centers h01=(10,10), h02=(50,10), h03=(10,30), and
h04=(50,30). Positive XY coordinates are passed directly on block.top.
R03: The sole body is named block; feature identifiers are lowercase h01-h04.
R04: Exactly one solid, with no fillets, chamfers, counterbores, text, or
extra components.
R05-R09: Geometric validation, analytical-volume comparison, CAD views,
presentation rendering, and final review are downstream tasks.

Nominal gross volume: 28800 mm^3.
Nominal removed volume: 432*pi mm^3.
Nominal final volume: 28800 - 432*pi = approximately 27442.832 mm^3.
"""

from steve import Model

model = Model("rectangular_four_hole_block")

model.box(
    "block",
    length=60.0,
    width=40.0,
    height=12.0,
    at=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    centered=False,
    name="block",
)
model.body_name("block", "block")

model.hole(
    "h01",
    on="block.top",
    points=[(10.0, 10.0)],
    diameter=6.0,
    depth=None,
    kind="simple",
    name="h01",
)
model.hole(
    "h02",
    on="block.top",
    points=[(50.0, 10.0)],
    diameter=6.0,
    depth=None,
    kind="simple",
    name="h02",
)
model.hole(
    "h03",
    on="block.top",
    points=[(10.0, 30.0)],
    diameter=6.0,
    depth=None,
    kind="simple",
    name="h03",
)
model.hole(
    "h04",
    on="block.top",
    points=[(50.0, 30.0)],
    diameter=6.0,
    depth=None,
    kind="simple",
    name="h04",
)

result = model.result()
